verdict.rationale: ELSTER documents a sanctioned software channel: any tax software that supports ELSTER can transmit through the same rail, and certificates authenticate submissions. This implies a programmatic interface (ERiC) that third parties integrate with, but the pack contains no public API documentation, and a single probe found the ERiC developer-artifact host timing out for a keyless client. Missing for 10: documented public API reference, open self-serve developer access, agent-friendly endpoints or auth flow, reachable developer artifacts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving ELSTER programmatically.
